skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand the basic theoretical issues related to banking law.
Students will comprehend the legal status of the State Bank of Vietnam.
Students will understand the legal status of financial institutions.
Students will be able to apply legal knowledge on banking operations and services provided by financial institutions.
Students will understand the legal framework for secured assets and asset disposal.
Students will develop skills to apply legal knowledge on central bank functions, roles, and authority; and in establishing and operating financial institutions.
Students will develop skills to resolve disputes in the banking sector and act as legal advisors for clients in the banking credit sector.
Students will develop the ability to independently research, study, accumulate, and enhance specialized professional knowledge.
